info.text:
The Fed hiked last month. Wednesday, we see if inflation's still climbing.
September CPI comes out Wed, Oct 14, 2026, at 8:30 AM ET. Forecasts point to about 3.6% a year, up from 3.4% in August.
Inflation peaked at 4.2% in May 2026 as gas prices soared. On Sept 16 the Fed raised rates to 3.75%-4%, its first hike since 2023.
Next Fed decision: Oct 28. Card and HELOC rates usually move with the Fed's rate; savings yields tend to lag.
Sources: BLS, Federal Reserve, consensus forecasts (Oct 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
